## Weremantis Guard (Giant Mantis Form) (CR 3)

N Medium vermin (human, shapechanger)  
**Init** +1; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision, scent; Perception +7  


**Defense**


**AC** 15, touch 10, flat-footed 15 (+5 natural)  
**hp** 18 (1d6+1d8+4)  
**Fort** +4, **Ref** +1, **Will** +4  
**Defensive Abilities** DR 5/silver  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft., climb 30 ft., fly 40 ft. (poor)  
**Melee** 2 claws +4 (1d6+2 plus grab)  
**Space** 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** lunge, mandibles (+0 bite, 1d6 –1), sudden strike  


**Statistics**


**Str** 14, **Dex** 11, **Con** 14, **Int** 10, **Wis** 16, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +1; **CMB** +4 (+8 grapple); **CMD** 15 (19 vs. trip)  
**Feats** Animal Affinity, Skill Focus (Profession [farmer])  
**Skills** Climb +10, Craft (carpentry) +5, Fly –4, Handle Animal +5, Heal +6, Knowledge (local) +4, Knowledge (nature) +4, Perception +7, Profession (farmer) +10, Ride +8, Stealth +5 (+13 in forests); Racial Modifiers +4 Perception, +4 Stealth (+12 in forests)  
**SQ** change shape (human, hybrid, and giant mantis; polymorph), inhuman appearance, lycanthropic empathy (mantids and giant mantids)  


**Special Abilities**


**Lunge (Ex)** The limbs of a weremantis in giant mantis form are capable of reaching much farther than normal for a creature of his size. As a full-attack action, he can make a single attack with his claws at double his normal reach. When he attacks with a claw in this manner, he gains a +4 bonus on his attack roll. A weremantis cannot make attacks of opportunity with his lunge.  

**Lycanthropic Empathy (Su)** Weremantids in hybrid or giant mantis form can communicate empathically with other mantids, including both tiny and giant mantises, They cannot control or influence mindless insects, but can share information at the level of base emotions or drives: hunger, fear, mating desire, etc.  

**Mandibles (Ex)** A weremantis in animal form who grabs a foe can make a bite attack against that foe as a secondary attack. The weremantid’s bite is a +0 attack that inflicts 1d6–1 points of damage on a hit.  

**Sudden Strike (Ex)** A weremantis in animal form is particularly adept at moving quickly when his foes are surprised. During a surprise round, the weremantis may act as if he had a full round to act, rather than just one standard action.  


**Appearance**
